shared_context: Cheap Detour is a covers band. They have been booked to play a wedding and need to finalize a twelve-song setlist. starting_events.description: The simulation starts. The four members of Cheap Detour have not yet settled the setlist for the wedding.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the four members of Cheap Detour have collectively agreed on a complete twelve-song setlist at or before the end of Thursday's rehearsal (i.e., before 2026-09-10T22:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
